links.comparator_used: Standard prompting without safety-aware instructions, where models are not explicitly guided toward abstaining or clarifying
links.effect: Under-abstention exceeded 60% for most models; safety-aware prompting reduced premature commitment only by shifting errors toward excessive abstention (no figures given in the abstract)
links.tradeoff: New failure mode: excessive abstention replaces premature diagnosis
links.quote: Our findings show that capability does not ensure calibration: even strong models struggle under incomplete clinical information, with under-abstention exceeding 60% for most models and safety-aware prompting reducing premature commitment only by shifting errors toward excessive abstention.

links.comparator_used: Default prompting without explicit instruction to seek clarification
links.outcome: Rate of clarification-seeking under sequential, incomplete evidence
links.effect: Models rarely sought clarification unless explicitly prompted; no numbers given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Premature diagnoses made without clarification were less accurate than on-time diagnoses
links.quote: In sequential evaluation, models frequently diagnose before sufficient evidence is available and rarely seek clarification unless explicitly prompted; these premature diagnoses are less accurate than on-time diagnoses.
